# NavigationArea

- Inherits [`Instance`](instance.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("NavigationArea")`

Marks the walkable ground inside its part's box with a `Label` (ADR 0098), which `NavigationService:SetAreaCost` prices: water an agent would rather go round, mud that is slow, a door that is shut. The part need not collide or be anchored -- it is a volume, not a floor. Ground no area marks costs 1.

**Members below are the ones this class DECLARES.** Everything its base
offers is on the base's page, which is what keeps one added member on
`Instance` from being a change to every page here.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Label` | `string` | `"Area"` | read/write | The name its cost is set by. Areas that share a label share a cost. |
